//: dotnet run rejects comments in this file, so its notes are properties whose names start with //. Nothing reads them.
commandName: dotnet run and isoplane dev use the first profile whose commandName is Project. Select another with --launch-profile NAME.
applicationUrl: sets the local port. A local session serves plain HTTP on loopback and ignores an https address.

environmentVariables: each one becomes an application setting, and overrides the same setting in appsettings files and User Secrets. Two underscores stand for a colon, so Greeting__Message is the setting Greeting:Message. Keep credentials in User Secrets, not here.
ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: names the environment, and with it which appsettings.{Environment}.json is read. Without it the environment is Production.

isoplaneLimitsOverride: remove the // from the property below to run the application under tighter limits. Its values are the ones a local session uses without it; lower the ones you want to try and delete the rest.
memoryBytes: the most memory an instance may use, in bytes; a multiple of 65536.
occupancyMsPerHttpDispatch: how long one request may keep a worker busy, in milliseconds. Time it spends waiting for I/O does not count.
subrequestsPerDispatch: how many outbound HTTP requests one request may start.
pendingFuturesPerDispatch: how many operations one request may be waiting on at once.
